_comment: A worked example of foreman/config.json for a team with SEVERAL Jira projects and MANY repos. Each project_routing value is an object that declares the repos that project owns, so a ticket in PAY can only route to payments repos; per-project status_map / story_points_field / issue_type overrides handle projects whose Jira workflow differs (team-managed projects each get their own story-points field); per-repo environment_id sends each child run into the cloud environment that actually has that repo's toolchain. Generate this file from your own source of truth with 'scripts/factory-init --projects-json @projects.json --target-repos-json @repos.json', and onboard one more project or repo later with --merge. Use foreman/config.example.json instead for the simpler single-repo setup.

PAY.description: Payments and billing — checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, payment-provider integrations, and the billing ledger.

SEARCH.description: Search and discovery — the query service, the indexing pipeline, ranking, and the search UI.

PLATFORM.description: Developer platform — CI, build tooling, shared libraries, and the factory agents' own playbook.

acme/payments-api.description: Payments API — Python/FastAPI service owning charges, refunds, and provider webhooks.
acme/payments-api.test_guidance: pytest; tests live next to the code in tests/test_*.py — add a failing-then-passing test, run it scoped, then the full gate.
acme/payments-api.environment_id: REPLACE_ME - environment id that clones acme/payments-api with Python + uv

acme/billing-worker.description: Billing worker — Go service that runs invoicing jobs and the billing ledger reconciliation.
acme/billing-worker.test_guidance: go test ./... ; table-driven tests live beside the package — add the failing case first.
acme/billing-worker.environment_id: REPLACE_ME - environment id that clones acme/billing-worker with Go

acme/search-service.description: Search service — Rust query and indexing service behind the search API.
acme/search-service.validate_command: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo test
acme/search-service.test_guidance: cargo test; integration tests live in tests/ — add the failing case, run it scoped, then the full gate.
acme/search-service.environment_id: REPLACE_ME - environment id that clones acme/search-service with the Rust toolchain
acme/search-service.runner_id: REPLACE_ME - a larger runner; the Rust build needs the memory

acme/webapp.description: Web app — TypeScript/React front end shared by several teams (checkout screens for PAY, results screens for SEARCH).
acme/webapp.test_guidance: vitest; component tests live beside the component as *.test.tsx — add the failing assertion first.
acme/webapp.environment_id: REPLACE_ME - environment id that clones acme/webapp with Node

acme/build-tools.description: Build tooling — shared CI actions, lint configs, and release scripts.
acme/build-tools.test_guidance: bats tests under tests/ — add the failing case first, then run ./scripts/ci.
